title: Aqara Smart Lock U400 with M100 Kit $399 Delivered @ Aqara Store
body:
Deal: Aqara Smart Lock U400 with M100 Kit $399 Delivered @ Aqara Store

[zzz17] Bought this during a pre-order deal, zero regrets. Probably my favourite purchase of the year. I don't carry my keys anymore, and charged it once since March or something (and I didn't need to really).
One thing worth noting: the hands-free unlocking using UWB isn't supported on Android (or at least not through Google Wallet on a Pixel). Apparently it's rolling out soon, but I haven't been able to use it for most of the year (and it's been coming soon all year…).
Also, you lose some hands-free convenience if you still have a door handle you need to turn to get inside.
[stirlo] How quick is the opening action? I have a U100 and I constantly find myself waiting for the bolt to retract.
I also have issues with the gyroscope detecting the door closed and extending the bolt while I'm still holding the door open (or even less than a second after I open it). Have you experienced anything like that?
[Brick50] Also have the U100 and my parents can’t help but jam it up whilst it’s retracting the bolt.
I haven’t had any issues at all with it extending the bolt when I’m holding the door, maybe it’s done it a couple of times over 18 months but I always figured I must have bumped the lock button on the keypad.
Would love to know anyone’s feedback who’s upgraded from U100 to this what differences they found
[Sunny84] Note that there is no UWB for Android as of yet and Aqara keeps saying its coming soon for months now without any updates….
[philsw] That actually changed in the last 24 hours.. at least announcement wise.. the updates are rolling out over the coming weeks apparently.
https://9to5google.com/2026/11/11/google-wallet-home-key/
Apparently the U400 is a launch partner
[InfamousCalf] Samsung's page is up for Aliro (UWB) - https://partners.smartthings.com/aliro-door-locks
Apple sell the deluxe version which has a better finish. It's a $150+ difference in Australia, but only like $30 in the US.
This is the finish material for the different versions of U400:
Standalone (Model DL-D06E & DL-D16E)
Touch panel: matte PC + PET
Outdoor panel & Indoor knob: Aluminium alloy with spray coating
Indoor panel: plastic
M100 Kit (Model DL-D06D & DL-D16D)
Touch panel: matte PMMA
Outdoor panel & Indoor knob: aluminium alloy with spray coating.
Indoor panel: plastic
Deluxe (Apple Store Version) (Model DL-D17D & DL-D15D)
Touch panel: matte PMMA
Outdoor panel & Indoor knob: zinc alloy with Electroplating + Brushed finish
Indoor panel: plastic
[Balljuice] Been waiting for this to go on sale. Cheers!
[vcdeal] https://forgeelectrical.com.au/aqara-smart-lock-u400-kit-bla…
Forge electrical give a 5% off(you don’t need any code) just create a new account
You’ll get it for $379.02
[boredofficeworker] Sign up to the newsletter- but it isn’t working for me at checkout. It errors out and says it isn’t available for the order. Maybe they removed the extra discount after, or OP didn't check all the way to checkout.
[DoaAn] Bought one of these for $390 (including postage) in August from Forge Electrical. It's really easy to install and set up. I have no regrets getting it.
I have an iPhone and UWB works really well. Typically, it's unlocking itself by the time I reach for the door handle. I did have some troubles with it delaying at first. My door is accessed by stairs and surrounded in a deep brick recess so it likely blocked the signal a bit. But I increased the sensitivity of some sensors settings (Unlock distance, Sensing duration and Blind Spot Assist), and that fixed it.
There's also fingerprint, code and key to unlock it, but I've never actually needed to use any of them.
Battery lasts a decent amount of time, even with the increased sensor sensitivity. It's taken 38 days to drop 17%.
[Brick50] Have you experimented with phone in front or back pocket?
My Mrs keeps her phone in her back pocket and that’s enough to stop the Tesla from unlocking 50% of the time (it uses UWB like this)
I wonder if it’s that sensitive or if your issue is the front door layout
[DoaAn] I've got an Apple Watch so I think that's the one that's triggering it to unlock.
I'm pretty sure the issue was the door layout. Door is recessed between 2 brick walls by a bit over a metre, before which you're walking up stairs along the side of the house. Basically exactly what the Blind Spot Assist setting is for.
[boredofficeworker] Which Model Tesla if you dont mind me asking?
[freoleo] Looks like Google have been dodgy and blocked UWB for most Pixel phones, only the 10 onwards can use it with this
Not good for a 9 fold owner
[Bobss] I'm still waiting for the Aqara Smart Gate Lock U500 to go on sale. It's never budged from its full price of $600 which is way too much IMO.
[Purec] I have the U400, although I bought the Deluxe Kit from the Apple Store for its better material finish and 2 included batteries instead of 1.
I use the Apple TV (Matter over Thread) to give it connectivity it needs for Home Assistant instead of this M100 dongle and for the UWB feature with iPhones.
Happy to share my experience and answer questions if anyone needs any info about it.
[Purec] of the physical doorlock?
outsourced to the door guy, it's pretty standard, he just drilled the typical standard holes that normal locks used and used the multi function tool to carve out the deadbolt strike plate on the door frame. I had 2 holes drilled on the door, 1 for the Aqara and 1 for the passage lever (to keep the door closed when aqara is unlocked).
There was 2 cables from the front to feed through and connect to the inside part. (Power, data and the antenna for UWB)
software-wise?
Aqara Home app to set it up via bluetooth and manage most of the settings. Apple TV to add remote lock/unlocking, seeing the lock status, adding it to Home assistant, UWB. (Adding other iPhones to use the UWB involves adding their Apple ID into your apple home that includes this lock and assigning them permission to access the door lock (which gives them the Home Key and UWB ability).
[Slowestdriver1] Pays for itself.
Equivalent to forgetting your keys once and calling out a locksmith
[functionalgrump] Opinions on the U100? I've got a GrapheneOS Pixel so will never be able to use UWB anyway, and I've got an Officeworks voucher (they don't sell the U400).
[GLAMOROUSFUNK] Great lock. Paired with the g410 doorbell which functions as a thread hub too. Would recommend.
